integrity: The stated all-size identities follow from a Dhar burning classification, an explicit reduced-Laplacian odometer table, and analytic counting. The two accompanying standard-library programs independently check finite instances. No independent external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact results apply to standard finite, unweighted, one-sink Abelian sandpiles on friendship graphs with at least two triangles, with uniformly sampled recurrent configurations and nonsink additions; they do not imply infinite-volume criticality or bounded-degree universality. Numerical verifications are finite corroboration, not the proof. Historical priority remains subject to independently inspected unindexed sources.
title: Sink relocation creates an extensive-avalanche law on friendship graphs
